day.headline: A Monkey day — Rat and Dragon are in step.

reasons: Rat and Monkey share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.message: Play it on the walk today. Take the song back.

reasons: Dragon and Monkey share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.message: Show them your seat number. Politely, but you're not moving.

reasons: Rooster sits apart from Monkey — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: a scarf that belongs to someone else
signs.message: Wear it out today. Tell them it lives here now.

reasons: Ox sits apart from Monkey — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Three-fifty to touch your own money. Walk the extra block.

reasons: Monkey's own day — your energy runs high
signs.message: Drop the cushioning. Just no, no paragraph underneath it.

reasons: Dog sits apart from Monkey — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Nobody's chasing that one. Finish it anyway, get it off you.

reasons: Tiger opposes Monkey — a day to take slowly
signs.message: Your neighbor's out there with soil. Ask what's going in.

reasons: Snake pairs with Monkey — a harmonious day
signs.motif: a reply that only needs one word
signs.message: One word closes it. Send the word, skip the paragraph.

reasons: Goat sits apart from Monkey — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Let them run the room today. Your point keeps till Wednesday.

reasons: Horse sits apart from Monkey — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Teeth apart all afternoon. Nothing today deserves that much grip.

reasons: Pig sits apart from Monkey — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Mail's stacking up and none of it's urgent. Tomorrow.

reasons: Rabbit sits apart from Monkey — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: That date you circled can uncircle itself. Tonight's for nothing.
